name: crm_data_enrichment_agent
description: Enrich CRM contacts and B2B leads with company data, validated emails, phone numbers, social links, and website signals. Supports JSON, CSV, and Apify datasets with deduplication, lead scoring, and optional Clearbit/Hunter enrichment for sales prospecting and automation workflows.
capabilities: Clean and enrich CRM contact lists with public web signals and third‑party enrichment.
Extract company and website metadata (titles, descriptions, contact pages, addresses).
Reduce manual research by automating website crawling for contact and company signals.

inputs.name: contactsSource
inputs.description: Where to load contacts from: JSON input, CSV text, or an Apify dataset ID.

inputs.name: contactsJson
inputs.description: Array of contact objects when source is 'json'. Each object should have at least an email; optional fields: firstName, lastName, company, phone.

inputs.name: contactsCsv
inputs.description: CSV string with headers when source is 'csv'. First row must be header names; use the field mapping options to match column names.

inputs.name: datasetId
inputs.description: Apify dataset ID when source is 'dataset'. The Actor will read items from this dataset up to the maximum contacts limit.

inputs.name: emailField
inputs.description: Property or column name for the contact's email in your data.

inputs.name: firstNameField
inputs.description: Property or column name for first name (optional).

inputs.name: lastNameField
inputs.description: Property or column name for last name (optional).

inputs.name: companyField
inputs.description: Property or column name for company (optional).

inputs.name: maxContacts
inputs.description: Maximum number of contacts to process. Earlier contacts are processed first.

inputs.name: dedupeKeys
inputs.description: Keys used to identify duplicates. Allowed: email, domain, companyNameNormalized, firstName, lastName. Add one key per line or use the JSON editor.

inputs.name: enrichment
inputs.description: Configure enrichment providers: website fallback (no API key), Clearbit, and Hunter.

inputs.name: crawling
inputs.description: HTTP request settings: rate limit (global across website, Clearbit, and Hunter), timeout, retries, and concurrency.

inputs.name: scoring
inputs.description: Configure contact quality scoring. Weights should sum to about 1.0.

inputs.name: integrations
inputs.description: Send run summary/results to n8n, OpenClaw, or a generic webhook endpoint after processing completes.

inputs.name: intelligence
inputs.description: Advanced controls for adaptive enrichment, caching, AI fallback, learning memory, routing intelligence, and cost guardrails.

inputs.name: output
inputs.description: Configure how results are written to the dataset and key-value store.

outputs.name: place_name
outputs.description: Business or place name when available.

outputs.name: address
outputs.description: Detected street address or location text when available.
